name: dsh-pet-indesktop
description: 给 DSH 网页界面加一只叫「大肥鱼」（昵称「鲸鲸」）的桌宠，八种配色皮肤随时切换，并且有性格：只吃米饭、聪明但懒、嘴硬心软；被连点几次会躺平，被叫「大肥鱼」会生气并坚持自己不胖，叫「鲸鲸」才高兴；她记仇也记好——今天被叫胖三次就冷淡，被叫昵称三次就亲近；离开半小时再回来她会嘴硬地说「才不是等你」；头几次见面她怕生；十分钟没人理就游去角落（只改视觉，不改你放她的位置）。A desktop pet called "Big Fat Fish" (nickname Jingjing) for the DSH web GUI, with eight switchable colour skins and a personality: she eats rice, is clever but lazy, and is a tsundere. Rapid clicks make her lie down and refuse to react; calling her fat annoys her and she insists she is not; the nickname 鲸鲸 pleases her. She keeps count both ways - three fat-calls today and she greets you cold, three nickname-calls and she greets you warm; come back after half an hour and she greets you with "I was not waiting for you"; the first few meetings she is shy; ten quiet minutes and she drifts to a corner, visually only, never moving the position you chose. The eight images are PNGs bundled with the plugin and served by the plugin itself.
author: Gjs9178U
